messages:
Ana (marketing): T-minus 72h — quick sync. Need: changelog blurb, docs link, webinar RSVP, benchmark blurb, and inbound lead routing. Who confirms canary window + rollback?
Mike (eng): Canary scheduled Tue 09:00 PT, 4h window. Traffic ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-rollback at error rate >3% or p95 > SLO.
Ana (marketing): Perfect. Mike, can you drop a 1-2 line changelog highlight we can use in the announce?
Mike (eng): Use this: "15% p95 token latency improvement for long-context workloads via adaptive KV caching." Then bullets for details: OOM fix on concurrent batching, regional fallback routing.
Sam (product): Messaging suggestion: "Lower latency for long contexts — more predictable performance at scale." Use that headline.
Julia (docs): Docs live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.2 — migration notes and quickstart included. Changelog anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.2#changelog
Ana (marketing): Julia, can you paste a 2-line code sample for the blog (small snippet)?
Julia (docs): Added snippet under Quickstart:```
# enable adaptive cache + batching
redwood.configure({"cache":"adaptive","batching":true})
```
Nisha (salesops): Routing plan: Webinar RSVPs -> SFDC Campaign "v2_3_launch"; company_size>500 -> AE queue Enterprise-North; others -> SDR nurture. I'll push mappings tonight.
Ana (marketing): Who will publish the RSVP landing page + GA params? Need UTMs for email and social.
Sam (product): Growth will publish landing at 10:00 PT tomorrow. UTMs: utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=v2.3.2_launch&utm_medium=email (for emails). Social will use utm_medium=social.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary roll at 1718922000, full ramp at 1718925600. Dashboard: https://infra.redwood.ai/deploys/abcdef
Mike (eng): Note: please avoid immediate high-volume links to the public announcement first 30m. We'll throttle if spike.
Ana (marketing): We'll stagger sends: email wave 1 at +30m, wave 2 at +3h, social after 1h.
Sam (product): Webinar set for day after launch, 2pm PT. We'll include a short benchmark slide (Mike's blurb + p95 chart).
Ana (marketing): Final ask — exact changelog line to link in the announcement?
Julia (docs): Use changelog anchor above. Verified: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.2#changelog
Nisha (salesops): Running test: submitting RSVP with company_size=1200 to validate AE queue mapping and SFDC tag. Will report.
Nisha (salesops): Test RSVP passed, campaign tag applied, AE queue assignment ok.
Ana (marketing): Great. I'll draft announcement with the blurb, docs link, RSVP link, and lead-routing note. Posting to #marketing-drafts in ~2h for review. :thumbsup:
Mike (eng): I'll post a short runbook with exact metrics to watch and a rollback snippet before canary. :eyes:
Julia (docs): Migration notes pinned to top of docs for easy linking.
Sam (product): +1. All set from product side.
